plugin_description: Bar widget and panel for a hosted Kimai instance: start, stop, and edit the running time entry.
title: Kimai

tooltip.not_configured: Kimai: set the URL and API token in plugin settings

errors.not_configured: Set the Kimai URL and API token in plugin settings.
errors.bad_time: Start time must look like 2:47 PM or 14:47.
errors.pick_project: Pick a project and an activity first.

base_url.label: Kimai URL
base_url.description: Base URL of the Kimai instance, without a trailing /api (e.g. https://kimai.example.com).

api_token.label: API token
api_token.description: A Kimai API token (Users → API access). Ignored when a token file is set.

credentials_file.label: Credentials file
credentials_file.description: Path to a secret file with two lines, the Kimai URL then the API token. Takes precedence over the inline values.

poll_seconds.label: Poll interval
poll_seconds.description: How often the bar widget re-checks the running entry, in seconds.

insecure_tls.label: Skip TLS verification
insecure_tls.description: Disable certificate and hostname verification. Only for a trusted endpoint on a private network.

show_project.label: Show project name
show_project.description: Prefix the elapsed time with the running entry's project.

hide_when_idle.label: Hide when idle
hide_when_idle.description: Hide the widget entirely when no timer is running.
